newsitem.title: POLAND: Bomb kills man, injures another in Warsaw.
newsitem.headline: Bomb kills man, injures another in Warsaw.

text.p: One man was killed and another injured by a bomb planted in an electrical transformer box outside a Warsaw apartment building on Monday, police said.
The blast in the eastern suburb of Praga also damaged several parked cars.
Public television, which identified the dead man only as 29-year-old Artur G., said he had been the target of another attack three months ago.
Police declined to comment on the likely motive behind the attack.
Dozens of similar blasts each year in Poland are caused by criminal gangs settling scores, fighting each other for dominance or enforcing extortion rackets.
